scope: Boolean overlap against the pose-interpolated wall before radial spring displacement. Overlap at loaded nodes is expected in this comparison. Segment results indicate where to refine the model and their volumes are not additive. A flat-ended cylinder checks the middle half of each intersecting segment independently. An unloaded-node segment can still intersect the adjacent moving wall. No physical pinch or load capacity is inferred.
